# Wiki fixtures

Real pages from the [Warhammer 40k Wiki](https://warhammer40k.fandom.com), saved on
2026-11-13 for the "Fill from wiki" tests (M7-T3): their wikitext as the MediaWiki API
returns it (`action=parse&prop=wikitext`).

- `gudrun.wikitext`: [Gudrun](https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Gudrun), with the
  `{{Planet}}` info box (`population`, `sub-sector`).
- `hubris.wikitext`: [Hubris](https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Hubris), with the
  `{{Infobox Planet}}` info box (`pop`, `subsector`).

The text is the wiki contributors' work, under
[CC BY-SA](https://www.fandom.com/licensing). It is kept here unchanged, only as test input.
